title: SwaraLM: code, frozen symbolic dataset and results for label-free Carnatic raga retrieval
description: Code, frozen symbolic dataset, raga theory table, trained checkpoints, embeddings and result files for the paper "Counting Still Wins: A Label-Free Evaluation of Melodic Representations for Carnatic Raga Retrieval". Seven representations (pitch-class histogram, svara-transition matrix, BM25, LSTM and Transformer language models, contrastive fine-tuning, ColBERT-style late interaction) are compared for query-by-example raga retrieval on Saraga Carnatic, with a phrase-level sub-study. Code is MIT licensed; the derived symbolic dataset and the raga theory table are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, inherited from Saraga Carnatic.
